selected_alternative: conditional analytic H3/H4 with injected stable log-window; H5 bounded 1D quadrature
not_selected: direct quadrature in original beta/s/rd coordinates; no automatic fallback or retry
entry: integrate_at_fixed_theta(joint, assembly_json, *, assembly_sha256, background_json, consumer_module, precision_json, precision_sha256, services)

scope.theta: fixed shared H0,ombh2,omch2; original domain/priors unchanged

reuse.trust: Caller verifies exact loaded objects/services and external admission; flags/pins alone are not authorization/certificates

H5.direction: D(theta) only in BAO indices3:16; reconstructed as pinned BAO means times rd_ref, rounding unbounded
H5.integration: q=qlo+(qhi-qlo)*u; positive scaled quadrature u in[0,1]

quadratic.a_zero: flat only if all projected components are float-exact zero; underflow otherwise is failure
quadratic.underidentification: Proper extra prior integrates to one if likelihood flat; does not relax nuisance rank63
quadratic.conditional_minimum_documentation: xref+clip(B/A,[lo-xref,hi-xref]), independent of prior; H4 B-lambda is not likelihood minimum

normalization.nuisance: Common kappa d_eta, log(kappa) omitted exactly as existing consumer
normalization.data: Euclidean measure on common fixed transformed affine support
normalization.full_cross_covariance: always inherited from joint; no block simplification

precision_admission.budgets: Explicit integers1..1000000; schema cap only, no execution budget granted here
precision_admission.error_targets: Explicit positive finite values; requests, not certified guarantees
precision_admission.references: id+sha256 for verified loaded services and caller verification

log_exp_quad_interval.target: log integral_L^U exp(h*z-A*z*z/2) dz, combined and stable
log_exp_quad_interval.domain: A>0; finite L<U, L<=0<=U; maximum-restricted anchoring
log_exp_quad_interval.must_not: ordinary CDF subtraction or isolated exp(h^2/(2A)) presented as stable in extreme tails

positive_quad_1d.target: scaled positive H5 integrand, original normalized prior preserved

receipt.convergence_and_precision_claim: receipt retained; no promotion to certified or assertion that requested target met

failures.engineering: exception aborts full collection, no model/region omitted
failures.legitimate_zero: complement of admitted common affine support, with own status; not underflow
failures.window_underflow: nonfinite log of positive finite window rejected
failures.quadrature_zero: positive mathematical integral cannot be inferred zero from nodes
failures.node_underflow: counted; no bound on missed mass inferred

output.quantity: conditional proper-extra-prior average, not theta-integrated evidence
output.certification: UNBOUNDED_THEORY_ERROR preserved; service-local errors do not bound all errors

minimum_future_verification: precision near tails/small curvature without artificial campaign
